title: Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
description: Architected an end-to-end autonomous driving pipeline using PyTorch and the CARLA simulator. Trained a deep autoencoder on ~8,000 frames from Cityscapes/CARLA, achieving sub-50ms inference for real-time decision making. Implemented behavioral cloning using CNNs to predict steering and throttle control with high precision.

title: InstaResume — AI Portfolio Engine
description: Engineered a high-performance resume builder with dynamic form handling and real-time preview synchronization. Integrated Google Gemini AI for automated keyword optimization and implemented client-side PDF rendering via @react-pdf/renderer. Focused on responsive templates and smooth state management for a seamless user experience.

title: BlogSpace — Full-Stack Platform
description: Developed a robust full-stack blog platform using MVC architecture and RESTful principles. Secured the application with JWT-based authentication and modular middleware for protected CRUD operations. Deployed on Render with a PostgreSQL backend, ensuring high availability and data integrity.
